scope: Preserve the retained Echo Base battlefield vehicles while routing their authored datatable armor through the PRE-CU mob protection objvar and cache instead of the inherited NGE expertise statistic.

eraEvidence.basis: The authenticated PRE-CU armor route consumes authored creature protection from armor.general_protection. Echo Base is retained later content, so its authored vehicle values remain content data but cannot acquire gameplay authority through an NGE expertise statistic.
findings: The retained battlefield vehicle table authors 10000 protection for the snowspeeder and 15000 for the Hoth AT-ST.
Twenty-one Echo Base spawn rows attach systems.vehicle_system.battlefield_vehicle: thirteen snowspeeders and eight Hoth AT-STs.
OnAttach reads default_armor and calls setArmor, making this a production initialization route rather than dormant compatibility code.

The inherited setArmor implementation wrote expertise_innate_protection_all, but the restored PRE-CU mob armor calculator intentionally reads armor.general_protection and does not read expertise statistics.

buildEvidence.sourceTest: passed; authenticated the authored vehicle table, all twenty-one production Echo Base attachments, the PRE-CU armor.general_protection write/cache route, and zero inherited vehicle armor expertise writes
buildEvidence.focusedJavaCompile: passed in an ephemeral in-memory directory that was removed immediately; emitted bytecode writes armor.general_protection, calls recalculateArmorForMob, and contains no expertise_innate_protection_all symbol

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: The retained battlefield vehicle initialization path can no longer discard authored armor behind an NGE expertise statistic.
auditBoundary.preserved: Echo Base vehicle templates, spawn counts, health, factions, allowed zone, driver and gunner attacks, special commands, passenger behavior, and authored armor magnitudes remain unchanged.
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: Other retained content-specific expertise references remain subject to later production-reachability audits.

requiredBeforeReady: Pass a clean full Java and x64 server build from the pushed direct-source pin.
Authenticate source/work parity and emitted battlefield vehicle bytecode.
Restart the server, observe the exact player-ready marker, verify the mapped x64 binary, and audit post-start logs.
